profile.subtitle: Your Git Rudder identity. It is what your team sees in invitations and activity.

account.subtitle: Your Git Rudder account, subscription and organization members.
account.readOnlyBilling: Only the owner manages the subscription.
account.planPrice: USD 8 per seat per month, billed yearly

vault.noRecovery: Nobody can recover your secrets if you lose the passphrase and the recovery code, not even Git Rudder support.

setup.title: Protect your secrets with a sync passphrase
setup.bodyAccounts: So your platform accounts reach your other devices, Git Rudder encrypts their tokens on this device before uploading them. Only you hold the key.
setup.bodyAiKeys: So your AI keys reach your other devices, Git Rudder encrypts them on this device before uploading them. Only you hold the key.
setup.whyNotPassword: It isn't your Git Rudder password. The server checks your password; this passphrase never leaves your devices. You need it even if you sign in with GitHub, GitLab or Google.
setup.hint: At least 12 characters. A phrase of several words is easy to remember and hard to guess.
setup.noRecoveryDetail: If you forget the passphrase and lose the recovery code, nobody can recover your secrets, not even Git Rudder support. You'd have to reconnect your accounts.
setup.notNowNote: With "Not now", what you add is saved on this device only.
setup.alreadyExists: You already have a vault created on another device. Unlock it with your passphrase.
setup.syncPrompt: Sync this account with your other devices? You need a sync passphrase that only you know.
setup.uploadFailed: The vault couldn't be created. The code you saved is still valid.
setup.doneBody: Your secrets now sync encrypted. Each new device will ask for the passphrase once.

error.tooShort: The passphrase needs at least 12 characters.
error.guessable: It's easy to guess. Add more words.
error.wrongPassphraseAgain: Can't remember it? Use the recovery code or see what to do if you forgot it.
error.codeTooShort: The code has 32 characters. Check that it's complete.
error.dailyLimit: You've requested your vault too many times today. Try again tomorrow.
error.changedElsewhere: The vault changed on another device. Try again.
error.oldKey: This device has an old key. Unlock the vault again.

code.title: Save your recovery code
code.body: It's the only way to open your vault if you forget the passphrase. You'll only see it now: Git Rudder doesn't store it.
code.noOne: Nobody else can recover it, not even Git Rudder support. Keep it somewhere other than this device.
code.saved: I've saved the code somewhere safe
code.oldVoid: The previous code no longer works.
code.label: Recovery code

unlock.title: Unlock your vault on this device
unlock.body: Enter your sync passphrase to use the accounts and keys you added on other devices.
unlock.afterRotation: Your vault key changed on another device. Enter your passphrase to keep using your synced accounts.
unlock.emailNotice: We'll email you to let you know this device now has access.
unlock.afterCode: You used the recovery code. Do you want to set a new passphrase now?

locked.banner: Your vault is locked on this device. You can see your synced accounts, but their tokens can't be used until you unlock it.
locked.test: Unlock the vault to test it
locked.accountInVault: This account is in your vault, which is locked on this device.

account.credentialsMismatch: The credentials don't match the account. Git Rudder won't use them.
account.resetFromWeb: Your vault was reset from the web dashboard. Set it up again to sync your secrets.
account.localTip: The token is only in this device's keychain. It isn't uploaded to the cloud.
account.savedLocal: Account saved on this device only
account.otherUser: Added with another Git Rudder account
account.otherUserAsk: This account was added with another Git Rudder account on this device. Upload it to yours?

card.title: Vault
card.none: Not set up. It's created the first time you sync an account or a key.
card.unlocked: Unlocked on this device · created on {date}

rotate.recommended: A device that had your vault was signed out. Rotate the key so that device can't read anything you upload from now on.
rotate.title: Rotate the vault key
rotate.body: Git Rudder creates a new key, re-encrypts your secrets and gives you a new recovery code. Your other devices will ask for the passphrase next time.
rotate.working_one: Re-encrypting {count} secret… Don't close Git Rudder.
rotate.working_other: Re-encrypting {count} secrets… Don't close Git Rudder.
rotate.done: Key rotated. Your other devices will ask for the passphrase.
rotate.newCodeWarn: The previous code will stop working.
rotate.newCodeAsk: Do you think someone knows the previous code?
rotate.needPassphrase: Enter your passphrase to rotate the key.

change.title: Change sync passphrase
change.otherDevices: Your other devices keep working without asking you for anything.
change.ask: Do you think someone knows your old passphrase?
change.askNo: No, I just want to change it
change.rotateInfo: Changing the passphrase isn't enough if someone knows the old one. We'll also rotate the key: you'll get a new recovery code and your other devices will ask for the new passphrase.

forgot.title: Forgot your passphrase?
forgot.otherDevice: Do you have another device with the vault unlocked?
forgot.otherDeviceHelp: Open it and go to {path}. In VS Code: {vscodePath}. You won't lose anything.
forgot.haveCode: Do you have the recovery code?
forgot.neitherHelp: You can reset the vault from the web dashboard. The encrypted copies of your accounts and keys are deleted from the cloud, and nobody can recover them, not even Git Rudder support. What each device has is kept, and the first device to create a new vault uploads it again.
